description: Choose a mode, a destination (or product URLs/IDs) and optional filters. The actor reads Booking.com's public attractions data with no account, cookies or proxy setup.

availabilityDate.description: Date for time-slot availability in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to tomorrow (mode=availability or includeAvailability).
availabilityDate.title: Availability date

category.description: Keep activities in this category. Applied after fetch and verified against each product's own categories (mode=search).
category.title: Category

customCity.description: City name or Booking.com city slug (e.g. 'kuala-lumpur', 'Porto'). Used when destination=custom.
customCity.title: Custom city

customCountry.description: Two-letter country code or country name (e.g. 'my', 'Portugal'). Used when destination=custom.
customCountry.title: Custom country

destination.description: City to search. Pick a popular destination or choose Custom and enter a city slug and country code below. Used by mode=search.
destination.sectionDescription: A destination is required for mode=search. Product modes use productIds or productUrls instead.
destination.title: Destination

endDate.description: Optional availability window end in YYYY-MM-DD format (mode=search or availability).
endDate.title: End date

freeCancellationOnly.description: Keep only activities with free cancellation (mode=search).
freeCancellationOnly.title: Free cancellation only

guideLanguage.description: Keep activities available with a guide in this language (mode=search).
guideLanguage.title: Guide language

includeAvailability.description: Fetch time slots for each product in search or product modes. Adds one request per product.
includeAvailability.title: Include availability

includeCalendar.description: Also fetch available dates and cheapest-price groups for the startDate/endDate range (mode=availability or productDetails).
includeCalendar.title: Include availability calendar

includeDetails.description: Fetch the full product record (all photos, inclusions, accessibility, additional info) for each search result. Adds one request per product.
includeDetails.title: Include full product details

includeReviews.description: Fetch guest reviews for each product. Adds one or more requests per product.
includeReviews.sectionDescription: Optional enrichments add requests per product. The daily prefill keeps them off.
includeReviews.title: Include reviews

language.description: Language for names and descriptions. Prices use the selected currency.
language.title: Content language

maxPrice.description: Keep activities at or below this representative price (mode=search).
maxPrice.title: Maximum price

maxResults.description: Maximum records to return (attractions, products, reviews products or destinations depending on mode).
maxResults.title: Maximum results

maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Maximum guest reviews to include per product.
maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product

minPrice.description: Keep activities at or above this representative price (mode=search).
minPrice.title: Minimum price

minRating.description: Minimum guest rating on Booking.com's 5-point scale (mode=search).
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviews.description: Keep activities with at least this many guest reviews (mode=search).
minReviews.title: Minimum review count

mode.description: What to fetch. Search lists activities for a destination; productDetails looks up specific products; availability returns time slots; reviews returns guest reviews; destinations lists the city catalogue.
enumTitles: Product details by URL or ID
mode.title: Mode

productIds.description: Booking.com attraction IDs (e.g. 'PRe4kSVWXdrD') or product URLs. Used by productDetails, availability and reviews modes.
productIds.sectionDescription: Use productIds or productUrls for productDetails, availability and reviews. A destination is not required for these modes.
productIds.title: Product IDs or URLs

productUrls.description: One or more Booking.com attraction product URLs. Used by productDetails, availability and reviews modes.

url.description: A public Booking.com attraction product URL.
url.title: Product URL

productUrls.title: Product URLs

query.description: Optional free-text search inside the destination, e.g. 'Eiffel', 'Louvre', 'food tour' (mode=search).
query.sectionDescription: Server-side filters narrow the result set. Category, price and minimum review count are verified after fetch for accuracy.
query.title: Search query

reviewSortBy.description: Review order when includeReviews or mode=reviews is active.
reviewSortBy.title: Review sort

skipTheLineOnly.description: Keep only activities labelled skip the line (mode=search).
skipTheLineOnly.title: Skip-the-line only

startDate.description: Optional availability window start in YYYY-MM-DD format (mode=search or availability).
startDate.title: Start date

wheelchairAccessibleOnly.description: Keep only activities labelled wheelchair accessible (mode=search).
wheelchairAccessibleOnly.title: Wheelchair accessible only

title: Booking.com Attractions Scraper Input
